scope: Unverified summary of the headline national rules for a visiting hobby pilot. Commercial filming, local by-laws and site permissions are not covered.

registrationRequired.note: Registration and a pilot certificate (basic or advanced) apply from 250 g; sub-250 g drones are exempt from both but not from the rules.

pilotCertRequired.note: Basic or advanced certificate from 250 g; foreigners can sit the online basic exam.

weightClasses.summary: Micro: no registration or certificate, still no flying over people or near aircraft.
Small: registration and basic/advanced certificate; NAV Drone for controlled airspace.

altitudeNote: General ceiling for hobby flights; lower limits apply near aerodromes and in restricted zones.
maxDistanceRule: Visual line of sight at all times.

insuranceRequired.note: No general mandate; provincial and site rules vary.

importRestriction.note: No import restriction known for personal drones.

noFlyHighlights: Within 5.6 km of airports and 1.9 km of heliports without authorization
National parks (Parks Canada prohibits take-off and landing without a permit)

cityNotes.note: Downtown is largely controlled airspace around Billy Bishop and Pearson; NAV Drone authorization applies.
Harbour and downtown sit under YVR and harbour heliport airspace; parks require permission.
Parks Canada bans drones in national parks without a permit.

notes: Written from general knowledge on 2026-09-19 without fetching the sources; not verified. Confirm on the authority page before flying.
